symptom: The CE provider added a valid proof-of-work CLI demo entrypoint, but the invalid help-only entrypoint remained in the composed candidate and the same semantic validation failed again.

dynamic_evidence.final_request_audit: CE identity, PM contract, target files, failure feedback, response schema, and forced structured-output tool were present.
dynamic_evidence.tool_result: Provider returned a schema-valid entrypoint_upsert; no removal operation existed in the advertised schema.
dynamic_evidence.composition_result: _replace_by_id appended the new id and preserved the old id, so full candidate revalidation failed on TASK-1::cli_help.

root_cause: ChiefEngineerSemanticRepairPatchV1 and its provider schema were upsert-only. Replacing an invalid obligation under a new id was inexpressible: the model could add a correct row but could not explicitly remove the diagnosed obsolete row.

fix.contract: Add optional entrypoint_remove_obligation_ids to the typed patch while retaining entrypoint_upsert as the diagnosis authority group.
fix.policy: A removal id must exist in the frozen candidate and the same patch must contain a same-owner, same-kind replacement; unknown or cross-owner removals fail closed.
fix.composition: Remove authorized obsolete rows before applying typed entrypoint upserts; include removed ids in the immutable repair receipt.
fix.provider_context: Expose removable ids and the replacement rule, and instruct CE to use the typed removal surface instead of leaving the invalid row beside its replacement.

guardrails: No generated Bench project file was modified.
No free-form delete path was added.
A removal without a same-owner same-kind replacement fails closed.
Unrelated candidate sections remain hash-preserved in the semantic repair receipt.
residual_risk: A provider may omit the optional removal field; full candidate validation remains authoritative and will reject the stale invalid entrypoint rather than accept a false green.
